name: Radiologists
oneLiner: The profession everyone predicted would vanish first, which instead got better at its hard half.
why: The job is a bundle: drafting reports was never the valuable part
Diagnostic accountability sits with a named clinician
AI output needs verification, and verification is expert work
threats: The drafting rung of the training ladder is disappearing
Radiology took 20 years of warnings and did not shrink — that is evidence, not comfort

claims.text: In a clinical trial, AI-generated report drafts cut junior radiologists' reading time by 18.5% and improved report quality, shifting work from drafting to reviewing, validating and correcting.
PwC classifies radiologists as professionalised by AI: routine tasks automated away, human expertise emphasised, and professionalised roles growing twice as fast as democratised ones.
